items.title: Intel (INTC) Stock Sees Fair Value Falls After Guidance And Operational Issues
items.summary: Intel’s latest valuation reset has pulled estimated fair value down from about US$107.21 to about US$90.65, putting fresh focus on how much risk investors are willing to take. That shift lines up with recent analyst commentary, where firms are reworking price targets after weighing strong data center momentum against weaker PC trends, supply issues and heavier spending plans. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative fits together and what signals to watch as opinion on Intel...
